pages.title: 资料输入
pages.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished desktop web application reference screenshot, landscape 16:10, high resolution with crisp Simplified Chinese interface text. Product: Java + RAG AI interview practice coach. This is a UI reference for a small real-user MVP, not a marketing landing page. Calm professional learning workspace, light warm-gray canvas, white surfaces, near-black typography, teal primary accent, subtle borders, restrained shadows, generous spacing, modern Chinese sans serif. Avoid excessive cards, gradients, decorative AI sparkles, huge hero titles, device frames, and browser chrome. Full desktop viewport edge-to-edge.
Shared consistent shell across this series: compact horizontal topbar with small teal line logo and product name “面试教练”, navigation “开始练习”, “我的记录”, “我的简历”, user “示例开发者”. Clear visual hierarchy, plausible readable Chinese, accessible contrast. Use realistic Java backend learning content. All counts are main questions; each main question may have at most one follow-up. No voice, agents, payment, public signup, coding judge, report export, model settings, or probability of hiring. Do not expose answers or evaluative feedback before the current main-question/follow-up unit is finished. Small unobtrusive bottom label “页面参考 · 示例数据”.
Screen 1 of 5: resume and job description preparation. Top stepper “1 准备资料 — 2 确认计划 — 3 模拟面试 — 4 查看复盘”, step 1 selected. Heading “为你的目标岗位做好准备”, subtitle “结合简历与岗位要求，生成单场面试计划”. Two spacious equal-width columns. Left title “你的简历”, uploaded readable file “Java后端简历.pdf” with success state “解析完成”, link “更换文件”, note “PDF / DOCX，最大 10 MB；PDF 最多 20 页”, tabs “解析正文”“粘贴正文”, editable resume text area containing succinct fictional Java developer project experience using Spring Boot / MySQL / Redis, character counter “1,286 / 20,000”. A small neutral note “请确认解析内容，可在生成计划前修改”. Right title “目标岗位 JD”, textarea with Java后端开发工程师 requirements: Java collections/concurrency/JVM, Spring Boot, MySQL indexing/transactions, Redis caching, project reasoning; counter “638 / 10,000”. Small privacy note below both columns “仅将必要内容发送给模型服务；技术依据来自已审核知识库”, service data explanation text link. Bottom alignment left “今日已用 3 / 20 次 · 生成计划不计次”, right enabled teal button “生成面试计划”. Do not display a matching score, an interview score, or a generated plan on this screen.
CF-04 current scope: reviewed knowledge-base RAG retrieval plus LLM generation and evaluation. No live web search, automatic page fetching, or model built-in browsing. Show insufficient-evidence limitations when applicable.
